reviewType: uncalibrated development review; not quality qualification
method: Post-key semantic audit of preserved blind free recognition. Requires object and requested modifier. No original recognition or craft judgments changed.
usableRule: semanticStatus == correct AND shipUnchanged AND no criticalDefects
